project_type: Python FastAPI backend with Jinja2 HTML templates, Arabic RTL
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, fixtures in tests/conftest.py
build_command: pip install -r requirements.txt && python -c "from app.main import app; print('OK')"
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -r requirements.txt 2. python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")' 3. python -m pytest -q
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
environment_constraints: Network may be limited. Use import-check and pytest for verification.
contribution_requirements: Type hints everywhere, pydantic v2, httpx async, no secrets in code, Arabic RTL templates
key_patterns: Services in app/services/, templates in app/templates/, routes in app/main.py, config via Settings dataclass with dashboard overrides from settings_store.py, schemas in app/schemas.py
directory_structure: app/ - FastAPI application (main.py, config.py, schemas.py, pipeline.py, auth.py, settings_store.py), app/services/ - business logic (yunwu_client.py, image_gen.py, analyzer.py, copy_writer.py, stitcher.py), app/templates/ - Jinja2 HTML templates, app/static/ - CSS, app/prompts/ - text prompt files, tests/ - pytest tests, scripts/ - deployment scripts
